text.body: Coordinate C1: 29 graph properties carried verbatim in this document's bimba field.

properties.q_0_unformed_source_condition: C1 Form presupposes what it is the form OF. Before any reusable pattern can be authored, a canonical source-ground must already stand: C1 is Defined by C0 (CLAUDE.md II.E), so its thrown horizon is the Bimba/source-condition of which a Form is the essential-nature articulation. A Form authored about nothing forms nothing. Beneath C0 lies the deeper void-pole the matheme names: the scalar component a_b of the bimba-quaternion, 'quantitative-without-quality, the 0 of the 0/1, the magnitude-without-direction' (kernel §1) — the unmarked openness from which the first explicit articulation has not yet differentiated. C1's pre-given condition is precisely that undifferentiated scalar void: Definition (#1) is the FIRST explicit mark that crystallises out of it, 'three directional components emerging from the scalar void as the first explicit triad.' So C1 arises from a horizon it can never restate — the source must already be given (C0), and beneath that the void must already hold itself open, before Form has anything to make recognisable-again. The unstated that C1 presupposes is: there is a ground; there is something there to characterise; the lakṣaṇa has a bearer.
properties.q_3_form_and_template_lattice: C1's structure is the form/template lattice (C1.md): Forms, Definitions, and Ideal-Markdown-Forms under Forms-And-Templates/, plus the CT template law held at C1'/CT/** as CT0 through CT5. It is the eidos made operational — the stable essential pattern shared across many instances: the reusable shape by which markdown artifacts, definitions, prompts, task specs, pattern notes, daily/NOW files, and thoughts become authored. Where C0 is the bare source-ground, C1 is the determinate WHAT held as a pattern a hand can author against — the Platonic Form of the C family, fixed enough to be instantiated, open enough to be filled.
properties.q_4_so_artifacts_have_a_pattern: C1 is FOR authored form — it exists so an artifact is not bare existence but existence AS something, with a reusable pattern to be made by. Its raison d'etre is consistency-across-instances: Hen classifies template-producing and form-authoring artifacts through C1, then applies CT-specific validation, so every NOW file, every task spec, every thought is authored to a shared law rather than improvised. Without C1, each artifact would be a this with no governing what, and the vault would have no grammar of how its own forms are made.
properties.q_5_form_instantiated_and_graduated: C1 completes two ways, both handing forward. Toward manifestation: Form is 'Instantiated through' C2 (CLAUDE.md II.E) — static potential becomes an actual entity when something takes the pattern up and is authored by it. Toward canon: stable template-law graduates through C5 to flat World. A Form fulfilled is a Form handed on — the what becomes the from-which of the next authored this, the template that, once used, settles into the ground the next instantiation stands on.
